node.label: Civil services & transfers
node.summary: IAS and police postings and reshuffles.

facts.text: SC clarified its **March 11, 2026** OBC non-creamy-layer judgment (excluding parental salary/agri income from the income test) does **not** require retrospective revision of service allocations or seniority across recruitment years; Civil Services Exam 2025 results (declared March 6) stand, with the creamy-layer principle only governing fresh allocation.
facts.plain: SC clarified its March 11, 2026 OBC non-creamy-layer judgment (excluding parental salary/agri income from the income test) does not require retrospective revision of service allocations or seniority across recruitment years; Civil Services Exam 2025 results (declared March 6) stand, with the creamy-layer principle only governing fresh allocation.

facts.text: Union Cabinet extended the Centrally Sponsored Scheme for **Fast-Track Special Courts** (incl. exclusive **POCSO** courts) by **5 years (to 31 March 2031)**; outlay **₹3,788.04 crore** (Centre ₹2,353.15 cr + States ₹1,434.89 cr) from the **Nirbhaya Fund**; **779** FTSCs (incl. 399 POCSO-exclusive) have disposed **4,02,457** cases since **2019**; plan to scale up to **850** FTSCs.
facts.plain: Union Cabinet extended the Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Fast-Track Special Courts (incl. exclusive POCSO courts) by 5 years (to 31 March 2031); outlay ₹3,788.04 crore (Centre ₹2,353.15 cr + States ₹1,434.89 cr) from the Nirbhaya Fund; 779 FTSCs (incl. 399 POCSO-exclusive) have disposed 4,02,457 cases since 2019; plan to scale up to 850 FTSCs.

facts.text: Kerala transferred **35 IAS officers**; K.R. Jyothilal became Additional Chief Secretary, Home and Vigilance.
facts.plain: Kerala transferred 35 IAS officers; K.R. Jyothilal became Additional Chief Secretary, Home and Vigilance.

facts.text: Kerala Crime Branch alleged deliberate manipulation in the **Kerala PSC** exam for the State Planning Board (10 questions excluded from evaluation); ex-Deputy Secretary **P. Satheesh** was arrested and KPSC chair **M.R. Baiju** is under scrutiny.
facts.plain: Kerala Crime Branch alleged deliberate manipulation in the Kerala PSC exam for the State Planning Board (10 questions excluded from evaluation); ex-Deputy Secretary P. Satheesh was arrested and KPSC chair M.R. Baiju is under scrutiny.

facts.text: Tamil Nadu raised the upper age limit for direct recruitment to State government services by **five years** (order by CM **C. Joseph Vijay**).
facts.plain: Tamil Nadu raised the upper age limit for direct recruitment to State government services by five years (order by CM C. Joseph Vijay).

facts.text: Principle: a legislature can validate an act struck down by courts only by removing the defect the courts found; it cannot simply declare a judgment ineffective (doctrine of separation of powers).
facts.plain: Principle: a legislature can validate an act struck down by courts only by removing the defect the courts found; it cannot simply declare a judgment ineffective (doctrine of separation of powers).

facts.text: SC (Justices **J.B. Pardiwala** and **K. Vinod Chandran**) struck down Karnataka's 2022 law validating the 'corrupt' **2011 KPSC** selection of 362 Group A and B gazetted probationers, saying it was enacted to overturn court judgments.
facts.plain: SC (Justices J.B. Pardiwala and K. Vinod Chandran) struck down Karnataka's 2022 law validating the 'corrupt' 2011 KPSC selection of 362 Group A and B gazetted probationers, saying it was enacted to overturn court judgments.

facts.text: U.P. revised character verification norms: people linked to organisations seeking to change the social or political system 'through violent means' are ineligible for government jobs, but political ideology alone or a pending FIR is not a bar.
facts.plain: U.P. revised character verification norms: people linked to organisations seeking to change the social or political system 'through violent means' are ineligible for government jobs, but political ideology alone or a pending FIR is not a bar.
